title: node/map
description: Run one operation per element of over, all at once. The element arrives as the input named item, or by bind (input -> path within the element, "" for the whole element); every other value in in is broadcast. The output is the index-ordered list of results.

type.description: Marks this node a map: it runs one operation per element of a list.

description.description: What this node does, for a reader of the graph.

label.description: A short human name for this node, shown wherever a reader sees it instead of its id.

bind.description: Inputs taken from within each element, by name, each a dotted path into it or "" for the whole element. A name bound here may not also be given in in (G006).

additionalProperties.description: A dotted path within the element, or "" for the whole element.

onItemFailure.description: What one element failing does: fail ends the node, collect keeps the successes. Absent: fail.
